title: ふろのじかん (Furo no Jikan)
description: A child takes a bath, and every step comes alive with sound and sensation — water rushing in (じゃあじゃあ), splashing and playing (ばしゃばしゃ、ぴちゃぴちゃ), scrubbing squeaky-clean hair (きゅっきゅっ), the warm haze of steam (ぽかぽか), dripping from the tap (ぽたぽた), a foggy mirror (くもくも), a soft fluffy towel (ふわっ), and that cozy sleepy feeling after a bath. Calm, sensory, and made for bedtime.
author: オリジナル
